color.summary: Cool greys on white, nearly neutral: #1f2328 ink, #59636e for secondary text, #d1d9e0 borders and #f6f8fa for bands and default buttons. Blue (#0969da) is links, focus and selection; green (#1f883d) is kept for the primary action and open states; purple marks merged. Dark mode is its own palette: #0d1117 page, #f0f6fc ink, #3d444d borders, a lighter blue (#4493f8) for links.
usage: The repository header and box headers sit on the #f6f8fa band; the page stays white.

type.summary: 14px on a 21px line for most of the UI, 12px on 18px for metadata, 16px for list titles and headings (600 for headings, 500 for issue titles). Primer asks for Mona Sans, but no face loads on github.com, so the system font renders. Code and the clone URL are monospace.

shape.summary: 6px corners almost everywhere: buttons, inputs, boxes, menu rows. Dialogs and overlays round to 12px. Avatars, labels and counters are full pills.

spacing.summary: A 4px base used in 2px steps: 8px is the most common gap, then 6px and 12px, with 16px around boxes. Controls are 32px (medium) or 28px (small).

elevation.summary: Mostly flat: borders separate things, not shadows. Buttons carry a 1px drop at 4% black and inputs a faint inset at the top. Dialogs and overlays share one floating shadow: a 1px ring plus two soft layers (6px 12px and 6px 18px).

button.summary: Primer's Button, read off github.com and Primer's Storybook. The product names its looks with data-variant: invisible (the most used, for toolbar actions), default, primary (green, the page's main action), danger, link and secondary. Two sizes cover almost everything: medium at 32px and small at 28px. Icon-only buttons are squares at the same heights.

invisible.note: No fill at rest, grey on hover: toolbar and overflow actions.
